title: CP64
summary: C64 emulator made for the small screen: game menu, disk swap, USB joystick
description: CP64 is a C64 emulator built for the CardputerZero, with a small frontend of its own around the VICE core. Copy your .d64, .prg, .crt or .tap files to ~/cp64/games and pick one from the menu, or name one autostart.d64 to start it right away. Disks can be changed while a game runs (Alt+D). The built-in keys work as joystick and keyboard; a USB joystick or gamepad is recognised when plugged in and then the keyboard types normally. The joystick port is remembered per game. Sound over the built-in speaker; the emulation runs at full PAL speed and draws straight to the 320x170 display. Tested on the device with several classic games, including a multi-disk game. No games are included, only a one-line BASIC maze demo to try it out. The package contains the VICE core with its built-in system ROMs, which belong to their respective owners.
